name: player_update_gun_dispatch_requests_from_trigger_latches
description: Player::UpdateGunDispatchRequestsFromTriggerLatches updates remote alt and primary dispatch request flags from trigger latches, OptCatalog flags, primary repeat timing, and alt-gun transition state. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly inspection in the current session verified the leaf body: netInputBit16Latch clears altGunDispatchRequested only when zero, otherwise sets it only when activeAltGunController->optCatalogEntry->flags has bit 1; netInputBit17Latch clears primaryGunDispatchRequested and returns only when zero; an active primary request is issued only when g_Player_TotalTimeSecScaled is at or beyond nextDispatchTime and altGunTransitionState has no 0x180 bits; nextDispatchTime is advanced by dispatchRepeatDelay.
The native smoke checks alt clear, alt preserve, alt set, primary clear, primary timed dispatch, early-time preserve, and alt-transition blocked preserve paths.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x41bab0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent player remote/network tick pass.
